name: Ice hockey rink (NHL)
headline: length
subtitle: NHL regulation rink (Official Rules 2025-2026)
description: An NHL rink is 200 feet long and 85 feet wide, with corners rounded on a 28-foot radius. The goal lines sit 11 feet in from each end, and the two blue lines are 64 feet out from the goal lines. Each goal opening is 6 feet wide and 4 feet high, and the boards around the ice stand about 42 inches tall.

facts.text: Goal lines are drawn 11 feet from each end of the rink, and the blue lines are 64 feet out from the goal lines, dividing the ice into three zones.
Safety glass rises 8 feet above the boards at each end of the rink and at least 6 feet along the sides.
An NHL puck is 1 inch thick and 3 inches across and weighs between 5.5 and 6 ounces.

sources.title: National Hockey League Official Rules 2025-2026, Rules 1, 2 and 13

caveats: These are NHL dimensions. International (IIHF) rinks are wider and use metric sizes.
